Objects made at startup run the new code on their next call.
A call that was already running finishes on the old code.
One limit: only method bodies may change.
Retransformation must not add, remove or rename fields or methods, or change signatures, modifiers or inheritance.

Retransformation swaps method bodies in place, for every object, but never the class's shape.

Which code does that thread finish on?
